Build a claims triangle from a table

Source: R/reserving.R
as_triangle.Rd

Makes the triangle of cumulative claims that the reserving functions take, from a table with a row per origin and development period (such as payments by accident year and development year), or from a table with a row per origin and a column per development period.

Usage

as_triangle(
  data,
  origin = "origin",
  development = "development",
  value = "value",
  cumulative = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame: in the long form with origin, development and value columns; in the wide form with a row per origin and a column per development period (and the origin in the column named by origin, or in the row names).

origin, development, value

The names of the origin, development period and value columns of the long form. For the wide form, give development = NULL and value = NULL, and origin the name of the origin column or NULL for the row names.

cumulative

TRUE (the default) if the values are cumulative, FALSE if they are incremental.

Value

A numeric matrix of cumulative claims, one row per origin and one column per development period, with NA for the future.

Details

In the long form, the origin and development periods are each sorted and taken to be consecutive: the development periods can be numbered (1, 2, ...) or ages (12, 24, ... months). Incremental values of the same origin and development period are added up, so claim transactions can be given as they are; a cell of the past with no value is then zero. The past is every cell on or before the latest calendar diagonal in the data. Cumulative values must have one value per cell of the past.

In the wide form, the values of each origin run from the first development period, with NA (or empty) for the future.

Examples

head(simulated_motor_claims)
#>   accident_year development_year    paid incurred earned_premium
#> 1          2014                1 1644095  3709012        8150000
#> 2          2014                2 1502381  1044516        8150000
#> 3          2014                3  714586   164925        8150000
#> 4          2014                4  491949   222467        8150000
#> 5          2014                5  362668    48340        8150000
#> 6          2014                6  249976    64828        8150000
as_triangle(simulated_motor_claims, "accident_year", "development_year", "paid", cumulative = FALSE)
